limitations.note: The rewrite corrected the write stride but replaced the original combinational full and empty comparisons with registered next-pointer logic, changing when the flags transition and which clock edges accept transfers.
The rewrite also added reset gating to both RAM enables, suppressing accesses that the original and corrected designs allow when the corresponding request and status permit them.
The scoreboard used the DUT's flags to decide which transfers counted and checked flag states after settling, so it could pass without detecting changes to cycle-by-cycle flag and handshake timing.

limitations.note: The initial test command was rejected because of its cleanup command, so no simulations ran until the test was resubmitted.
The trailing Git check failed and gave the command a nonzero exit status even though the simulations had passed.
